description: Use when you need a domain lookup, whois, dns records or certificate transparency data for osint, security or due diligence. Do not use for historical whois, registrant personal data (redacted by registries) or port and vulnerability scans. Returns JSON with domain intelligence: WHOIS/RDAP registration, DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CAA), SPF and DMARC, and TLS certificates from certificate transparency logs for 0.02 USDC per call. Typical response time 4000 ms (p95). Category: Data. Price: US$0.02 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

certificates.description: Include issued TLS certificates from Certificate Transparency (crt.sh); true when omitted

domain.description: Domain name in ASCII (punycode for internationalized names), e.g. example.com
